name: UC&GN International Corp.
summary: UC&GN International Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, assembly, packaging, and sale of light-emitting diodes (LED) solutions in Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company operates through International Trade, Vehicle, and Household Supplies divisions. It offers LED components for automotive, motorcycle, SMD, PLCC, high power, IR, UR, and lamp applications; touch monitors for medical and industrial industries; and red dot sight solution for aviation and defense sectors. The company was formerly known as UPEC Electronics Corp. and changed its name to UC&GN International Corp. in August 2017. UC&GN International Corp. was founded in 1991 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
